body:
Now: Cleaning's only XP is litter: 10 pieces a day x 2 XP = 20 a day. Cleaning 30 takes about 220 game days, 50 takes 613. The hard challenge 'every skill to MAX' (500 coins) is only reachable through claw prizes.
New:
- Litter gives 5 XP a piece (50 a day).
- In the Pets and Farm Update: cleaning the pet yard and pet beds gives Cleaning XP (fits the pet needs).
Effect: Cleaning 30 in about 60-80 game days, like the other skills.

comments.text: Approved by Karolis ('do the rebalance', 30 Oct). Litter 5 XP is in the patch (build 2026103101). Pet-yard cleaning XP comes with the Pets and Farm Update.

short: Cleaning levels faster: litter gives 5 XP
source: chat 2026-10-30: Schedules and economy red team 2
title: Balance 8: Cleaning can actually level up
